comments.author: @UnseenPlanett
comments.text: What shocks you more about life in Bangladesh — families surviving in Dhaka’s overcrowded slums or rivers turning black from pollution? And who should be held responsible for protecting the people living with these conditions every day? #reallifeinbangladesh #bangladeshtravel

comments.author: @EarthRevealed-e1b
comments.text: Watching this really changed the way I see Bangladesh. It's heartbreaking to see people working so hard just to survive, especially the children and those risking their lives in dangerous jobs. What struck me most is how families can spend years building a home and lose everything overnight. These people deserve more than just survival. They deserve safety, dignity, and a better future. Respect to the people of Bangladesh!

comments.author: @AmazingDiscoveriesTopUS
comments.text: The stories of sewage cleanes and garment workers really stayed with me. No one should have to risk their life just to earn a living.
